item.title: Bergman, Slotkin Discuss Tariffs as Trump Defends Trade Policy in State of the Union
item.description: During the State of the Union, President Donald Trump defended his trade and tariff strategy — even though the Supreme Court ruled Friday that he violated federal law by using emergency authority to impose global tariffs.

item.title: Whitmer’s Final State of the State Focuses on Literacy, Housing, Health Care, and New Push on Medical Debt, Zoning Reform
item.description: In her eighth and final State of the State address, Gov. Gretchen Whitmer outlined a 2026 agenda centered on literacy, housing affordability and health care costs. The governor proposed several new initiatives, including a state affordable housing tax credit, zoning reforms, medical debt protections and permanent free school meals.

item.title: U.P. Lawmakers React “Whitmer’s Legacy in U.P. Is Lost Opportunities” After Final State of the State
item.description: State Rep. Dave Prestin, R-Cedar River, sharply criticized Gov. Gretchen Whitmer following her final State of the State address, accusing her of neglecting Upper Peninsula communities. Prestin cited energy policy, the Line 5 tunnel project and oversight of the Department of Natural Resources as key concerns.
